details: VRAINS (遊☆戯☆王VRAINS, Yū Gi Ō Vureinzu) is a Japanese anime series created and animated by Nihon Ad Systems (NAS) and Gallop. It is the fifth anime spin-off in the Yu-Gi-Oh! franchise. The series aired in Japan on TV Tokyo from May 10, 2017 to September 25, 2019. It was simulcast outside of Asia by Crunchyroll courtesy of Konami Cross Media NY. It premiered in the United States on November 3, 2020 on Pluto TV. The term 'VRAINS' derives from 'Virtual Reality' (VR), 'Artificial Intelligence' (AI), 'Network System' (NS). The series revolves around the exploits of the protagonist Yusaku within the virtual world named VRAINS. In addition to featuring previous summoning mechanics, VRAINS introduces the new "Link Summon" mechanic. The series was succeeded by Yu-Gi-Oh! Sevens, which premiered in Japan on April 4, 2020.

explainer.lead: Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS is the fifth anime spin-off in the Yu-Gi-Oh! franchise, animated by NAS and Gallop and aired in Japan from 2017 to 2019. Its name draws on Virtual Reality and Artificial Intelligence, tying the series to AI themes.

tiers.eli5: It's a cartoon series about card duels in a virtual world run by artificial intelligence.
tiers.practitioner: It is entertainment media, not an AI system, so engineers encounter it only as a cultural reference. A pitfall is mistaking its fictional AI for a technical source.
tiers.paperLevel: No formal definition applies; it is an animated series, and its AI content is narrative rather than technical.
